title: Community Pothole Repair - Tijuana
description: Volunteer-organized pothole repair initiative covering major boulevards in Tijuana. We provide materials, you provide the hands.
descriptionEs: Iniciativa de reparacion de baches organizada por voluntarios cubriendo los principales bulevares de Tijuana. Nosotros proporcionamos materiales, tu las manos.

title: Community Pharmacy - Free Medicine
description: Free medicine distribution for low-income families. We collect donated medications and distribute them to those who cannot afford prescriptions.
descriptionEs: Distribucion gratuita de medicamentos para familias de bajos recursos. Recolectamos medicamentos donados y los distribuimos a quienes no pueden pagar recetas.

title: Beach Cleanup Ensenada
description: Monthly beach cleanup along the Ensenada coastline. Join us to keep our beaches beautiful and protect marine life.
descriptionEs: Limpieza mensual de playa a lo largo de la costa de Ensenada. Unete para mantener nuestras playas hermosas y proteger la vida marina.
schedule: First Saturday of every month, 7:00 AM - 11:00 AM
